name: cli-tool-file-organizer
description: Build a CLI tool that organizes files by type — tests the pipeline's ability to create a complete Click application with tests.
request: Create a Python CLI tool using Click that organizes files in a directory by type. The tool should: (1) accept a source directory path as argument, (2) have a --dry-run flag that shows what would happen without moving files, (3) categorize files into folders: images/ (jpg, png, gif, svg), documents/ (pdf, doc, docx, txt, md), code/ (py, js, ts, go, rs), data/ (csv, json, yaml, xml), and other/ for everything else, (4) handle duplicate filenames by appending a number suffix, (5) print a summary of files moved per category. Include pytest tests covering all categories, dry-run mode, and duplicate handling.
acceptance_criteria: CLI accepts a directory path argument
--dry-run flag shows planned moves without executing
Files are categorized into correct folders by extension
